posts.name: bluedarky
posts.cooked:
HappiestMeal:

That's really to bad.  I really would love to have all of them.  I would love to just buy them, like everyone who doesn't have them, but I would rather the creators make new expansions rather than work on re-releasing old promos. 

This is a big misconception, there is no work in releasing old promos, it's just a matter of redoing printsheets and sending them to the printer.

The reason why they aren't doing it yet is twofold, first to keep the rewards for supporting the product through pre-orders unique, secondly because they want to release all of them at once.

Hell, look at the uproar over them releasing a new oversized villains pack, there were several people who purchased one of the original packs with everything up to Shattered Timelines who don't like the idea of repurchasing everything to get Agent of Gloom Spite, Skinwalker Gloomweaver, Wrath and future promos.
